segments.speaker: daughter
segments.hakka_characters: 客家妹好冇？
segments.hakka_romanization: Hak-kâ-mûi hó móu?
segments.english: Are Hakka girls good?
segments.dutch: Zijn Hakka-meisjes goed?
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 你看𠊎好冇？你看惹媽好冇？
segments.hakka_romanization: Ngì khon ngài hó mò? Ngì khon ngâ mâ hó mò?
segments.english: Do you think I'm good? Do you think your mum is good?
segments.dutch: Vind je mij goed? Vind je je moeder goed?
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 冇乜個好囉，好惡。
segments.hakka_romanization: Mò mak-ke hó lò, hó ok.
segments.english: Nothing much good about me, very fierce.
segments.dutch: Er is niet veel goeds aan mij, ik ben erg fel.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 毋好𠊎會養大惹兜？養大惹兜都冇分人。
segments.hakka_romanization: M̀-hó ngài voi yông-thai ngâ-têu? Yông-thai ngâ-têu tû mò pûn ngìn.
segments.english: If I weren't good, would I have raised you all? I raised all of you myself and never gave you away.
segments.dutch: Als ik niet goed was, zou ik jullie dan allemaal hebben grootgebracht? Ik heb jullie allemaal zelf grootgebracht en nooit aan iemand afgestaan.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 你講𠊎客家妹好冇呢？
segments.hakka_romanization: Ngì kóng ngài Hak-kâ-moi hó mò nê?
segments.english: Tell me, am I—a Hakka girl—good or not?
segments.dutch: Zeg eens, ben ik als Hakka-meisje goed of niet?
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 惹阿爸，該時啊，割樹膠啊。
segments.hakka_romanization: Ngâ â-pâ, kái-sṳ̀ â, kot su-kâu â.
segments.english: Your dad, back then, when tapping rubber trees.
segments.dutch: Jullie vader, vroeger, toen hij rubberbomen tapte.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 佢割一樖，𠊎割十幾樖，𠊎看著嘅囉！
segments.hakka_romanization: Kì kot yit phô, ngài kot sṳ̍p-kí phô, ngài khon-tó ke lò!
segments.english: He tapped one tree while I tapped over ten trees, I saw it with my own eyes!
segments.dutch: Hij tapte één boom terwijl ik er meer dan tien tapte, ik heb het met eigen ogen gezien!
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 佢割到⋯⋯哈哈哈！佢割爛去，啊喲，割爛去！
segments.hakka_romanization: Kì kot-tó... hahaha! Kì kot-lan hi, â-yô, kot-lan hi!
segments.english: He cut until... hahaha! He cut and damaged the tree, oh dear, cut a hole right in it!
segments.dutch: Hij bleef snijden... hahaha! Hij beschadigde de boom, o jee, hij sneed er een gat in!
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 抓兜泥來，糊落去，唔分頭家看著。哈哈哈！
segments.hakka_romanization: Tsâ têu nài lòi, fù lo̍k hi, m̀ pûn thèu-kâ khon-tó. Hahaha!
segments.english: I grabbed some mud/soil and plastered it over, so the boss wouldn't see it. Hahaha!
segments.dutch: Ik pakte wat modder of aarde en smeerde het erop, zodat de baas het niet zou zien. Hahaha!
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 頭家看著就唔得囉。
segments.hakka_romanization: Thèu-kâ khon-tó chhiu m̀-tet lò.
segments.english: If the boss saw it, we'd be in trouble.
segments.dutch: Als de baas het zag, zouden we in de problemen komen.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: daughter
segments.hakka_characters: 乜嘢人割爛去？
segments.hakka_romanization: Mat-yéh yàn got-laan heui?
segments.english: Who damaged the tree?
segments.dutch: Wie heeft de boom beschadigd?
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 佢割得過快就割爛嘛！
segments.hakka_romanization: Kì kot tet ko khuai chhiu kot-lan mâ!
segments.english: He cut too fast so he damaged it!
segments.dutch: Hij sneed te snel en beschadigde hem daardoor!
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: daughter
segments.hakka_characters: 我嘅阿爸？
segments.hakka_romanization: Ngóh ge aa-bàa?
segments.english: My dad?
segments.dutch: Mijn vader?
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 抓兜泥來，糊落去。
segments.hakka_romanization: Tsâ têu nài lòi, fù lo̍k hi.
segments.english: Grabbed some soil and plastered it on.
segments.dutch: Ik pakte wat aarde en smeerde het erop.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 佢割到爛去，有空，就冇空囉！
segments.hakka_romanization: Kì kot-tó lan hi, yû khûng, chhiu mò khûng lò!
segments.english: He cut it open so there was a hole, and then there was no hole anymore!
segments.dutch: Hij sneed er een gat in, en daarna was er geen gat meer!
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 如今念到啊，真係好笑。
segments.hakka_romanization: Yì-kîm ngiam-tó â, chṳ̂n-he hó-seu.
segments.english: Thinking about it now, it's really funny.
segments.dutch: Als ik er nu aan terugdenk, is het echt grappig.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 𠊎對佢講：「割快兜，冇就搵毋到食啦！」促佢。
segments.hakka_romanization: Ngài tui kì kóng: "Kot khuai têu, mò chhiu vún-m̀-tó sṳ̍t lâ!" Chhuk kì.
segments.english: I told him: "Tap a bit faster, otherwise we won't be able to make a living!" Urging him on.
segments.dutch: Ik zei tegen hem: "Tap wat sneller, anders kunnen we niet in ons levensonderhoud voorzien!" Ik spoorde hem aan.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: daughter
segments.hakka_characters: 哦，我嘅阿爸好慢？
segments.hakka_romanization: Ó, ngóh ge aa-bàa hóu maan?
segments.english: Oh, my dad was very slow?
segments.dutch: O, was mijn vader erg langzaam?
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 係，一樖就大空，該擺頭家看著就炒魷魚，冇得食囉，該擺冇飯食。
segments.hakka_romanization: He, yit phô chhiu thai khûng, kái-pái thèu-kâ khon-tó chhiu chháu-yù-ǹg, mò-tet sṳ̍t lò, kái-pái mò fan sṳ̍t.
segments.english: Yes, one big hole in the tree; that time if the boss saw it he'd fire us, we'd have no livelihood, no rice to eat.
segments.dutch: Ja, één grote holte in de boom; als de baas die toen zag, zou hij ons ontslaan. Dan hadden we geen inkomen en geen rijst om te eten.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 抓兜泥來，糊落去，糊啊，頭家來就看毋到囉，冇空囉！
segments.hakka_romanization: Tsâ têu nài lòi, fù lo̍k hi, fù â, thèu-kâ lòi chhiu khon-m̀-tó lò, mò khûng lò!
segments.english: Grabbed some soil, plastered it on, plastered it over—when the boss came he couldn't see it, no more hole!
segments.dutch: Ik pakte wat aarde en smeerde het erop; toen de baas kwam, kon hij het niet zien: geen gat meer!
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 𠊎就係恁樣，乜個都做過囉。
segments.hakka_romanization: Ngài chhiu he án-ngióng, mak-ke tû cho-ko lò.
segments.english: That's just how I am, I've done everything.
segments.dutch: Zo ben ik nu eenmaal, ik heb van alles gedaan.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 如今𠊎都好值得囉，養大惹兜都恁疼𠊎，去哪位都用輪椅推𠊎。
segments.hakka_romanization: Yì-kîm ngài tû hó chhṳ̍t-tet lò, yông-thai ngâ-têu tû án thiàng ngài, hi nài-vui tû yung lùn-yí thûi ngài.
segments.english: Now I feel it was all worth it; all of you whom I raised love me so much, pushing me in a wheelchair wherever we go.
segments.dutch: Nu voelt het allemaal de moeite waard; jullie van wie ik grootgebracht heb, houden zoveel van me en duwen me overal in een rolstoel naartoe.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 𠊎自家念到，值得，值得！𠊎兜辛苦都值得！
segments.hakka_romanization: Ngài chhṳ-kâ ngiam-tó, chhṳ̍t-tet, chhṳ̍t-tet! Ngài-têu sîn-khú tû chhṳ̍t-tet!
segments.english: When I think about it myself, it's worth it, worth it! All our hard work was worth it!
segments.dutch: Als ik er zelf aan terugdenk: het was de moeite waard, de moeite waard! Al ons harde werk was het waard!
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 呵呵呵，都好開心。
segments.hakka_romanization: Hehehe, tû hó khôi-sîm.
segments.english: Hehehe, I'm very happy.
segments.dutch: Hahaha, ik ben heel blij.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 去哪位都有𠊎份，𠊎就開心囉。
segments.hakka_romanization: Hi nài-vui tû yû ngài fun, ngài chhiu khôi-sîm lò.
segments.english: Wherever they go I'm included, so I'm happy.
segments.dutch: Waar ze ook naartoe gaan, ik hoor erbij, dus ben ik blij.
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 食有𠊎份，尞有𠊎份，如今𠊎都好開心！
segments.hakka_romanization: Sṳ̍t yû ngài fun, liàu yû ngài fun, yì-kîm ngài tû hó khôi-sîm!
segments.english: Eating includes me, going out for fun includes me; nowadays I am very happy!
segments.dutch: Ik doe mee met eten en plezier maken; tegenwoordig ben ik heel gelukkig!
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review

segments.speaker: mother
segments.hakka_characters: 客家人，記得 comment, share, like, follow！
segments.hakka_romanization: Hak-kâ-ngìn, ki-tet comment, share, like, follow!
segments.english: Hakka people, remember to comment, share, like, follow!
segments.dutch: Hakka-mensen, vergeet niet te reageren, te delen, te liken en te volgen!
segments.verification_status: user-provided; Dutch translated from English, pending review
